localizedValues.name: S1-Kitchen Shelter
localizedValues.description: Enjoy the scenic views and convenience of this beach side Kitchen Shelter on the majestic Hood Canal. This convertible facility can be open to the warm breezes of summer or closed up to protect your group from the northwest rains. The shelter includes picnic style tables that seat 8 each, electrical service and food preparation area. Groups wishing to use special equipment such as dunk tanks or inflatable bouncer toys must contact the park in advance (360-275-0668) to apply for a special activity permit. Shelter must be vacated no later than dusk. Parking is abundant but is shared with the general public so plan ahead, arrive early and carpooling is always encouraged.  Shelter uses should plan accordingly and arrive early.

localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description: Pet Friendly. Per night pet fee applies, declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or at the park when you check in. Read and understand pet rules. This cabin is furnished with a heater, air conditioner, queen-size futon, bunk bed that sleeps three, table with four chairs, and small end table. Outside is a picnic table and fire pit with grate. Bathrooms and showers are nearby. No cooking, no smoking inside the cabin. Bring your own bedding.
